content.title: International Paper (NYSE:IP) Beats Q4 CY2025 Sales Expectations
content.summary: Packaging and materials company International Paper (NYSE:IP) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 31.1% year on year to $6.01 billion. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.08 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
